因为有熟人，这架是没打成的，时笙被林一一请进了缥缈宗。

一些人就算面露愤怒，却也不敢发出来，叶清秋不在缥缈宗，林一一如今又是天尽峰峰主的亲传弟子，兼职峰主夫人，他们哪里敢招惹。

最重要的是，他们干不过！

好吧，就算干得过，林一一转眼就会带着天尽峰峰主来找麻烦，简直是将不要脸的精髓发挥到了极致。

“师父竟然走了？”这是时笙完全没料到的结果。

玉箫离开缥缈宗了，如今的天尽峰峰主是白琅。

“嗯，当初你的事传来，师尊就离开，一开始还会传消息回来，后面就没了消息。师叔，当年在桐山派到底发生什么？为什么那些人说你在练邪功？”

练邪功？

时笙挑眉，“和我说说，他们怎么说我的？”

当年她用那个方法离开后，龙玦和叶清秋不知怎么就闹了起来，两人还打了一架，后来龙玦离开回了仙界，叶清秋也回了缥缈宗。

关于时笙的流言，也是在那之后传出来的。

说她抓了水灵根的女弟子，在练什么邪功，后来被人发现，各大宗门围剿之下，竟然被她跑了。

当时还有不少人满世界的找她。

“叶清秋和龙玦打了一架？”

男女主竟然干了一架，看来当初她想让男女主相杀相恨的理想也不是做白日梦嘛！

“嗯……”林一一抓了抓下巴，“我也是听从桐山派回来的人说的，好像是为了楚凝……具体的不清楚。”

她连龙玦是谁都不知道。

不是，师叔，你的重点不对啊！

楚凝……

当初她把叶清秋扔掉的尸体给扛回去，可是费了不少的力气。她也只是想给叶清秋添添堵，没有想利用楚凝做什么。

后来发生了什么？让龙玦和叶清秋竟然因为楚凝干架？

从林一一口中，时笙知道了不少事。

比如叶清秋这些年身边有不少男修，且还都和叶清秋有那种关系。

现在缥缈宗的男弟子，都以爬上叶清秋的床为目标。

只要和叶清秋扯上关系的男修，他们的修为都比普通弟子要高上许多。

再比如，白琅娶了自己的徒弟林一一……

Because there were acquaintances, the fight was not successful, and Shi Sheng was invited into the Piaomiao Sect one by one by Lin Yiyi.

Even if some people showed anger, they did not dare to express it. Ye Qingqiu was not in the Piaomiao Sect, and Lin Yiyi was now the direct disciple of the master of Tianjin Peak and part-time as the wife of the peak master. How could they dare to provoke him.

The most important thing is that they can't do it!

Well, even if he can do it, Lin Yiyi will bring the master of Tianjin Peak to find trouble in the blink of an eye, which is simply taking the essence of shamelessness to the extreme.

"Master is gone?" This was a result that Shi Sheng did not expect at all.

Yuxiao left the Piaomiao Sect, and the current leader of Tianjin Peak is Bai Lang.

"Well, when the news about you came out, the master left. At first, he would send news back, but then there was no news. Master uncle, what happened in the Tongshan sect back then? Why did those people say you were practicing evil arts?"

Practicing evil skills?

Shi Sheng raised his eyebrows, "Tell me, what did they say about me?"

After she left in that way, Long Jue and Ye Qingqiu got into trouble for some reason, and the two even had a fight. Later, Long Jue left and returned to the fairy world, and Ye Qingqiu also returned to the Piaomiao Sect.

Rumors about Shi Sheng also spread after that.

She said that the female disciple who had captured Shui Linggen was practicing some evil skills. Later, she was discovered and was surrounded and suppressed by various sects, but she actually ran away.

At that time, there were still many people from all over the world looking for her.

"Ye Qingqiu had a fight with Long Jue?"

The male and female protagonists actually had a fight. It seemed that her original ideal of wanting the male and female protagonists to kill each other and hate each other was not just a daydream!

"Well..." Lin Yiyi scratched his chin, "I also listened to the people sent back by Tongshan. It seems to be for Chu Ning... I don't know the details."

She didn't even know who Long Jue was.

No, Uncle Master, your focus is wrong!

Chu Ning...

It took a lot of effort for her to carry back the body that Ye Qingqiu had thrown away.She just wanted to cause trouble for Ye Qingqiu, and didn't want to use Chu Ning for anything.

What happened next?Let Long Jue and Ye Qingqiu actually fight over Chu Ning?

Shi Sheng learned a lot from Lin Yi's mouth.

For example, Ye Qingqiu has been surrounded by many male cultivators in recent years, and they all have that kind of relationship with Ye Qingqiu.

Now the male disciples of the Piaomiao Sect all aim to climb into Ye Qingqiu's bed.

As long as the male cultivators have a relationship with Ye Qingqiu, their cultivation levels are much higher than those of ordinary disciples.

For another example, Bai Lang married his apprentice Lin Yiyi...
